cues.zhText: 聊到这儿，细心的你可能会问：教科书里炎症常说的“增生”去哪了？其实，只有当急性阑尾炎反复发作、拖成慢性阑尾炎时，修复性的“增生”才会真正登场。
cues.enText: You might wonder: where is the "proliferation" of inflammation? Only when recurrent acute episodes turn into chronic appendicitis does reparative proliferation appear.

cues.zhText: 镜下可见阑尾壁明显纤维化、伴随淋巴细胞等慢性炎细胞浸润。慢性阑尾炎的手术时机核心原则是：一旦确诊，通常建议在症状缓解期择期切除；若正处于急性发作期，则视情况急诊手术。
cues.enText: Microscopy shows wall fibrosis and chronic inflammatory infiltration. Core surgical rule: once diagnosed, elective resection in remission is usually advised; during acute flare-ups, emergency surgery as indicated.

cues.zhText: 从粉白到暗红、灰黄再到焦黑，这根“小香肠”的每一次变色，都是身体发出的求救信号。面对转移性右下腹痛、高热与腹部拒按，别硬扛、别乱吃止痛药，尽早就医！
cues.enText: From pink to dark red, yellow, and black, every color shift is an SOS. Facing migratory right lower abdominal pain, fever, and guarding, never tough it out—seek prompt care!
